verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a policy, setting, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Self-hosting (bolna-docs-9), Indian data residency (bolna-docs-20), and bring-your-own provider keys are related privacy and deployment controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
